claim: The Champions League dataset had one campaign where two real players were each listed twice under different roles
The campaign with duplicate players was Young Boys, 2024-25
Sandro Lauper was listed twice under roles CB and DM
Joël Monteiro was listed twice under roles RM and ST
The duplicate listings caused the draft screen to show two separate candidate cards for the same person in one squad
The duplicate cards allowed the same player to fill two different slots
Duplicate rows for both players were removed at index.html lines 2444-2446
A code fix was made in the build() function at index.html lines 3295-3306
Campaign player lists are now deduped by name before being turned into draft candidates
Verification was performed using a scripted browser session with Playwright
The Playwright session forced the draft onto the Young Boys 2024-25 campaign
Before the fix, both duplicate cards were clickable and enabled
After the fix, each player appears as a single card
After the fix, the campaign's roster correctly shows 9 unique players instead of 11 with two dupes
